verdict.rationale: Bento is an AI-agent observability platform, so a built-in assistant is a fair axis, but the evidence shows no in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to. Its AI features are adjacent: plain-English signals and alerts are specific detection features, and its Agent Skills hand work to external coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
